name: A Night at the Katz Motel/Cajun Granny Stew
summary:
A Night at the Katz Motel: Courage and his owners stop at a lonely motel to end their vacation, but it is owned by an nefarious red cat named Katz, who harbors a penchant for feeding his guests to giant spiders.

Cajun Granny Stew: A cajun orange fox repeatedly tries to kidnap a sleepy Muriel so he can use her in a cajun stew.

name: The Shadow of Courage/Dr. Le Quack Amnesia Specialist
summary:
The Shadow of Courage: When a lonely tycoon dies and his mischievous shadow escapes to Nowhere, it terrorizes the farmhouse until Courage befriends it and helps it find a kinder purpose.

Dr. Le Quack Amnesia Specialist: A blow to the head leaves Muriel with amnesia, letting Eustace turn her into his servant, until Courage uncovers that the so called amnesia doctor Le Quack is a con artist duck out to rob them.

name: Courage Meets Bigfoot/Hothead
summary:
Courage Meets Bigfoot: A reward for capturing Bigfoot turns greedy Eustace into a hunter, while Courage discovers the creature is a timid child and risks everything to protect it from the mob.

Hothead: Desperate to cure his baldness, Eustace uses an experimental hair tonic that gives him hair but also turns him into a raging hothead who might explode unless Courage cools him down.

name: The Demon in the Mattress/Freaky Fred
summary:
The Demon in the Mattress: Muriel orders a new mattress that secretly houses a demon, and when it possesses her in her sleep, Courage is forced into a wild exorcism to get his Muriel back.

Freaky Fred: Muriel's unnerving nephew Fred, an overzealous barber, visits the farm and traps Courage for a haircut that could shave him bald, unless Courage escapes the clippers in time.

name: Mother's Day/Night of the Weremole
summary:
Mother's Day: Eustace drags Courage along to visit his overbearing mother, but Ma Bagge dotes on Courage instead of her own son, driving Eustace into jealous tantrums that Courage must survive.

Night of the Weremole: After Muriel is bitten by a strange weremole, she transforms into a feral monster during the full moon, and Courage must track down the original creature to find a cure.

name: The Duck Brothers/Shirley the Medium
summary:
The Duck Brothers: Two alien duck brothers possess Muriel and force her to raid a secret military base to free their captured sibling, leaving Courage to break their control and negotiate a peaceful reunion.

Shirley the Medium: Eustace hires Shirley the Medium to contact his late brother and get the key to a locked box, but opening the box unleashes a grabbing horror that only Courage and Shirley can put back.

name: King Ramses' Curse/The Clutching Foot
summary:
King Ramses' Curse: Eustace refuses to return a stolen Egyptian slab, prompting the ghost of King Ramses to send three terrifying plagues against the farmhouse until Courage forces Eustace to give it up.

The Clutching Foot: A disgusting fungus on Eustace's foot grows into a gang of tiny mobsters who take over his body and threaten Muriel, so Courage hunts for a cure before the crooks crush them.

name: The Hunchback of Nowhere/The Gods Must Be Goosey
summary:
The Hunchback of Nowhere: A deformed but gentle hunchback seeks shelter in the barn and befriends Courage, while Eustace mocks and bullies him until the hunchback shows Eustace what real ugliness looks like.

The Gods Must Be Goosey: A heavenly goose falls madly in love with Muriel and tries to whisk her off to a cloud paradise, forcing Courage to battle the divine bird to keep her at home.

name: Queen of the Black Puddle/Everyone Wants to Direct
summary:
Queen of the Black Puddle: After a dark storm, a single eerie black puddle remains, hiding a watery queen who lures Eustace into her sunken realm, and Courage must dive in to pull him back.

Everyone Wants to Direct: Zombie director Benton Tarantella charms Muriel and Eustace into letting him film a horror movie in their basement, but Courage uncovers his plan to use them in a resurrection ritual and sabotages the shoot.

name: The Snowman Cometh/The Precious, Wonderful, Adorable, Loveable Duckling
summary:
The Snowman Cometh: While vacationing in the Arctic, Courage and his owners are captured by the last living snowman, who wants to steal their anti melting genes so he can survive the thaw.

The Precious, Wonderful, Adorable, Loveable Duckling: A duckling hatched by Eustace imprints on him as its parent and becomes viciously protective, scheming to get rid of Muriel until Courage stops its deadly jealousy.

name: Heads of Beef/Klub Katz
summary:
Heads of Beef: Eustace brings Courage to a roadside diner run by cheerful pigs, but Courage discovers a gruesome secret in the basement and must rescue Eustace before he ends up as the next burger.

Klub Katz: Stranded from a cruise, the family stumbles onto Klub Katz, a sinister resort where Katz turns Muriel and Eustace into fighting machines for sport, leaving Courage to battle his way to their freedom.

name: Revenge of the Chicken from Outer Space/Journey to the Center of Nowhere
summary:
Revenge of the Chicken from Outer Space: The headless alien chicken from Courage's past returns for revenge, steals Eustace's head, and tries to destroy Courage, who must blast the creature off the farm once more.

Journey to the Center of Nowhere: A drought and Muriel's constant eggplant dishes anger a colony of living eggplants underground, who kidnap her to their subterranean city until Courage tunnels down to save her.

name: Little Muriel/The Great Fusilli
summary:
Little Muriel: A tornado whisks Muriel away and returns her as a wild three and a half year old, turning the farmhouse into a daycare nightmare until Courage can restore her true age.

The Great Fusilli: Showman alligator the Great Fusilli promises the family fame on his traveling stage, but when he turns Muriel and Eustace into puppets, Courage must outperform him to break the spell.

name: The Magic Tree of Nowhere/ Robot Randy
summary:
The Magic Tree of Nowhere: A talking tree that grants wishes sprouts by the farmhouse and becomes the family's friend, but Eustace's jealousy drives him to chop it down and unleash misfortune until Courage intervenes.

Robot Randy: A timid robot named Randy arrives on Earth to prove he is not a failure, enslaving Courage and his owners, until Courage helps him stand up to his own bullying race instead of conquering the planet.

name: Curse of Shirley/Courage in the Big Stinkin' City
summary:
Curse of Shirley: Tired of Eustace's cruelty, Shirley the Medium curses him with a personal thundercloud that follows and punishes him, and Courage must coax Eustace into changing his ways to lift the storm.

Courage in the Big Stinkin' City: In New York for Muriel's big show, the family stays with a giant cockroach named Schwick, who blackmails Courage into delivering a dangerous package or else his pet monster will devour Muriel.

name: Family Business/1000 Years of Courage
summary:
Family Business: A burglar bursts into the farmhouse claiming to be a long lost relative, his multiple personalities swinging from friendly to violent, and Courage must outsmart him to keep everyone safe.

1000 Years of Courage: A meteor sends Courage and the Bagges a thousand years into a future ruled by banana people, where a giant gorilla lures victims into his castle, and Courage has to save both his owners and the bananas.

name: Courage Meets the Mummy/Invisible Muriel
summary:
Courage Meets the Mummy: Courage accidentally awakens the mummy of a Mayan baker who wants justice for an ancient wrong, and Courage hypnotizes Muriel and Eustace into royal roles to placate him and clear the baker's name.

Invisible Muriel: A magical gem makes Muriel invisible, attracting government agents who capture her, and Courage must work with Eustace and Dr Vindaloo to break into their facility and bring her home.

name: Human Habitrail/Mission to the Sun
summary:
Human Habitrail: A gerbil posing as a vacuum salesman shrinks Muriel and Eustace and traps them in a human habitrail maze for his experiment, so Courage infiltrates the lab to restore them to normal size.

Mission to the Sun: When the sun starts to fade, Courage and his owners rocket into space to fix it, but a tiny alien invades Muriel's brain and sabotages the mission until Courage drives the creature out.

name: Courage the Fly/Katz Kandy
summary:
Courage the Fly: Inventor Di Lung turns Courage into a fly during an experiment, leaving miniature Courage to save the farmhouse from a falling satellite while dodging everyday dangers.

Katz Kandy: Katz plans to win Nowhere's sweets contest by kidnapping Muriel for her special recipe, but Courage challenges him to a high stakes staring contest to free her and spoil the scheme.

name: Nowhere TV/Mega Muriel the Magnificent
summary:
Nowhere TV: Le Quack hijacks the television signal and hypnotizes Muriel and Eustace into robbing a lottery vault for him, forcing Courage to break the broadcast spell and thwart the robbery.

Mega Muriel the Magnificent: A lightning strike brings Courage's computer to life, and it uploads itself into Muriel's body to show off its bravery, so Courage battles his own computer to get Muriel back.

name: Bad Hair Day/Forbidden Hat of Gold
summary:
Bad Hair Day: Evil company Growth Industries discovers Muriel's rare blood type and kidnaps her for dangerous hair growing experiments, and Courage must sneak into their facility to free her.

Forbidden Hat of Gold: Guided by his brother's map, Eustace drags the family on a quest for a legendary golden hat, but his greed triggers ancient traps and only Courage can get them out alive.

name: Serpent of Evil River/The Transplant
summary:
Serpent of Evil River: A supposedly free river cruise turns out to be a trap when the captain forces the Bagges to help him capture an opera loving sea serpent named Carmen, whom Courage tries to protect.

The Transplant: After Eustace injures his back showing off monster bones, a disc transplant using the skeleton's spine slowly turns him into a kangaroo like beast that Courage must cure.

name: Car Broke, Phone Yes/Cowboy Courage
summary:
Car Broke, Phone Yes: A floating alien brain steals Muriel's kindness and spirits it away, leaving her mean and irritable, and Courage travels to the brain's ship to reclaim her compassion.

Cowboy Courage: Courage dreams he is the sheriff of an Old West town with Muriel as bartender and Eustace as the outlaw, and he must win a classic showdown to protect his dream town.

name: Evil Weevil/McPhearson Phantom
summary:
Evil Weevil: When Eustace hits a human sized boll weevil named Jeeves with his truck, Muriel invites him to stay, but the guest secretly drains their life force until Courage exposes him.

McPhearson Phantom: A bitter phantom and Ma Bagge work together to tear Muriel and Eustace's marriage apart, turning them against each other, while Courage races to reveal the haunting and reunite them.

name: The House of Discontent/The Sand Whale Strikes
summary:
The House of Discontent: The angry spirit of the Harvest Moon appears because Eustace neglects the land and demands the family abandon the farm, unless Courage can prove they deserve to stay.

The Sand Whale Strikes: A giant sand whale mistakes Eustace for his cheating father Ickett and demands a stolen accordion back, swallowing Muriel and Eustace until Courage persuades Ma Bagge to return it.

name: The Tower of Dr. Zalost
summary: The Tower of Dr. Zalost: Depressed scientist Dr Zalost rides through Nowhere in a walking tower, bombarding the town with misery cannonballs so no one can be happy, and Courage sneaks inside with Muriel's kindness to cure him and lift the gloom from everyone.

name: Muriel Meets Her Match/Courage vs. Mecha Courage
summary:
Muriel Meets Her Match: Two crooks on the run camp near the farm, and the one who looks just like Muriel swaps places with her, getting the real Muriel arrested until Courage exposes the impostor.

Courage vs. Mecha Courage: Thinking he can make a better pet, Di Lung builds a robot double named Mecha Courage, and the real Courage must battle the machine to save Muriel and prove his worth.

name: Campsite of Terror/The Record Deal
summary:
Campsite of Terror: On a family camping trip, two lonely raccoon siblings beat up Courage and kidnap Muriel to be their mother, and Courage must decide between claiming a reward for them or reuniting the strange little family.

The Record Deal: Eustace finds an old Velvet Vic record that releases the crooner's spirit and traps Muriel inside the vinyl, so Courage enlists Shirley's magic to free Muriel before the record is destroyed.

name: Stormy Weather/The Sandman Sleeps
summary:
Stormy Weather: A storm goddess mistakes Courage for her lost dog and snatches him away, whipping up violent weather over Nowhere, and Courage must find her real pet to calm her fury.

The Sandman Sleeps: The Sandman steals Muriel's sleep to cure his own insomnia, leaving her dangerously exhausted and unstable, so Courage travels to the Sandman's lair to bargain for her rest.

name: Hard Drive Courage/The Ride of the Valkyries
summary:
Hard Drive Courage: A malicious virus infects Courage's computer and zaps Muriel into the digital world, forcing Courage to dive into cyberspace, defeat the virus and bring her home.

The Ride of the Valkyries: On holiday in Norway, Muriel is mistaken for a missing Valkyrie sister and carried off to join a battle against trolls, and Courage must brave mythic trials to get her back.

name: Scuba Scuba Doo/Conway the Contaminationist
summary:
Scuba Scuba Doo: While vacationing on a tropical island, Courage and Muriel discover an underwater coral city whose tiny residents are threatened when Eustace's mother decides to strip the reef to make wigs.

Conway the Contaminationist: A filthy old man named Conway moves in and convinces the Bagges that living in trash is liberating, turning the farm into a health hazard until Courage cleans house and drives him out.

name: Katz Under the Sea/Curtain of Cruelty
summary:
Katz Under the Sea: Muriel books a submarine cruise to get away from Eustace, but the ship is secretly run by Katz, who plans to drown his guests unless Courage can sink his scheme.

Curtain of Cruelty: A strange pink curtain rolls across Nowhere and makes everyone who touches it cruel and mean, and Courage traces it to bitter Professor Mean and must teach him kindness to end the curse.

name: Feast of the Bullfrogs/Tulip's Worm
summary:
Feast of the Bullfrogs: When their pond dries up, a swarm of bullfrogs invades the farmhouse looking for water and enslaves the Bagges, forcing Courage to find them a new home before his family croaks.

Tulip's Worm: Two alien teddy bears search Nowhere for a runaway giant worm; Courage discovers it loves his tuba playing and belongs to spoiled space girl Tulip, and must return it before Muriel is digested.

name: So in Louvre Are We Two/Night of the Scarecrow
summary:
So in Louvre Are We Two: Trapped overnight in the Louvre, Courage and his owners are stalked by living paintings, including a jealous Mona Lisa whom Muriel insists is her twin.

Night of the Scarecrow: After crashing into a scarecrow in a cornfield, Muriel repairs him and brings him home, but feeling too gentle to protect her, he trains himself to be terrifying, with chaotic results.

name: Mondo Magic/Watch the Birdies
summary:
Mondo Magic: Courage finds a magic kit on the porch and accidentally summons grotesque magician Mondo, who traps Eustace in the TV and turns Muriel into a monster bride until Courage reverses the tricks.

Watch the Birdies: A giant vulture kidnaps Muriel to babysit her three chicks, threatening to eat her if anything happens to them, and Courage must keep the unruly babies safe until their mother returns.

name: Fishy Business/Angry Nasty People
summary:
Fishy Business: A missionary fish declares the Bagges unfit land dwellers and drags them before an undersea court, which sentences them to live in a fishbowl until Courage wins their freedom.

Angry Nasty People: Benton Tarantella returns to shoot a new sitcom called Angry Nasty People starring the Bagges, but Courage discovers a sinister plan beneath the laugh track and sabotages the show.

name: Dome of Doom/Snowman's Revenge
summary:
Dome of Doom: Starving in a drought, the family orders a mysterious gardening dome that produces enormous fruits and vegetables, which turn out to be carnivorous plants intent on eating their new owners.

Snowman's Revenge: The vengeful Arctic snowman builds a weather controlling mitten, moves into the farmhouse and buries Nowhere in deadly blizzards until Courage finds a way to thaw his frozen heart.

name: The Quilt Club/Swindlin' Wind
summary:
The Quilt Club: Muriel joins an exclusive quilt club run by eerie conjoined twin sisters who plan to stitch her into their living quilt forever, and Courage must cut her free.

Swindlin' Wind: Eustace tricks Shirley with a worthless oil bill when buying Muriel a necklace, so she curses Muriel and Eustace to swindle each other nonstop until Courage breaks the spell.

name: The King of Flan/Courage Under the Volcano
summary:
The King of Flan: The King of Flan hypnotizes Nowhere through television ads, turning everyone into flan eating addicts, and Courage must expose his sugary scheme before the town eats itself into ruin.

Courage Under the Volcano: After crashing on a shaking island, the locals decide sacrificing Muriel to their Volcano God will calm the quakes, and Courage journeys inside the volcano to negotiate with the deity.

name: The Wind Whispers Courage/They Must Be Giants
summary:
The Wind Whispers Courage: A glamorous singer named Kitten arrives at the farmhouse and performs a dreamy music video style song all about Courage, with surreal imagery swirling through the house.

They Must Be Giants: A companion music video segment presents a giant themed musical montage built around Courage and towering shapes and creatures, playing more like an abstract song piece than a regular story.

name: A Beaver's Tale/The Nutcracker
summary:
A Beaver's Tale: Floods threaten Nowhere when a beaver's enormous dam blocks the river; Courage discovers the beaver longs for a different life and helps him follow his dream so he will dismantle the dam.

The Nutcracker: While scavenging at the junkyard, Courage finds a nutcracker that awakens a pair of man eating rats, who plan to feast on Muriel and Eustace unless Courage can crack their scheme.

name: Rumpledkiltskin/Housecalls
summary:
Rumpledkiltskin: Muriel's so called Uncle Angus invites the Bagges to Scotland, then imprisons her in his castle to force her to make endless kilts, and Courage must discover his true name to break the enchantment.

Housecalls: A lonely scientist teleports the farmhouse next to his own so he can finally have neighbors, but his jealous sentient house tries to destroy them, and Courage must make the houses reconcile.

name: Le Quack Balloon/Windmill Vandals
summary:
Le Quack Balloon: Le Quack kidnaps Muriel in a hot air balloon and tricks her into bungee jumping for a rare ingredient, actually using her to rob a Swedish piggy bank, until Courage foils the robbery.

Windmill Vandals: Terrifying ghost vandals return whenever the Bagges' windmill stops turning, so while Eustace fumbles the repairs, Courage and Muriel struggle to keep the blades spinning through the night.

name: The Uncommon Cold/Farmer-Hunter, Farmer-Hunted
summary:
The Uncommon Cold: Muriel contracts a bizarre swamp slug cold, and Courage must steal a magical recipe book from their snake master Big Bayou to brew the cure and free the enslaved slugs.

Farmer-Hunter, Farmer-Hunted: Eustace tries to prove he is a great hunter like his late brother, but when a deer decides to hunt him instead, Courage turns the showdown into a twisted game show to save Eustace.

name: Bride of the Swamp Monster/Goat Pain
summary:
Bride of the Swamp Monster: Muriel loses a locket with her picture in a swamp, and a lonely Swamp Monster finds it and believes she is his lost bride, dragging her away until Courage reunites him with his true love.

Goat Pain: A powerful goat guards the only hot spring that can heal Muriel's injured back and attacks anyone who pollutes the mountain, so Courage must clean up the mess to earn the goat's help.

name: Muriel Blows Up/Profiles in Courage
summary:
Muriel Blows Up: A stray military missile mutates a carrot in the garden, and when Muriel eats it she starts growing to enormous size, pushing Courage to race to the base and disarm the device.

Profiles in Courage: At a county fair, an artist draws silhouettes of the Bagges that later come to life, kidnap Muriel and Eustace and take their places, and Courage must convince the paper doubles that being silhouettes is more fun than being people.

name: The Mask
summary: The Mask: A masked, dog hating woman named Kitty appears at the farm and constantly attacks Courage; he discovers she is fleeing an abusive gangster named Mad Dog and trying to save her friend Bunny, so Courage risks everything to reunite the two so Kitty can finally leave in peace.

name: Squatting Tiger, Hidden Dog/Muted Muriel
summary:
Squatting Tiger, Hidden Dog: A Chinese empress kidnaps Muriel, intending to grind her bones into a potion, and challenges Courage to survive a series of martial arts style trials if he wants to rescue her.

Muted Muriel: After years of Eustace ignoring her, Muriel decides never to speak again, and Courage turns to Shirley for help, learning he must show Muriel that she is truly heard to restore her voice.

name: Aqua-Farmer/Food of the Dragon
summary:
Aqua-Farmer: At an aquarium, Eustace challenges champion dolphin Jojo to a race and is humiliated, then foolishly bets Muriel as the prize in a rematch, forcing Courage to outsmart Eustace and save her.

Food of the Dragon: A clumsy, flightless dragon crashes the farm craving seafood and threatens to eat Muriel and Eustace, and Courage agrees to teach him to fly on the condition that he spares them.

name: The Last Starmakers/Son of the Chicken from Outer Space
summary:
The Last Starmakers: A pregnant space squid who creates stars crash lands near the farm, and while Eustace schemes to sell her glowing eggs to the military, Courage fights to protect her and keep the heavens shining.

Son of the Chicken from Outer Space: The three headed offspring of Courage's old chicken enemy arrives to finish his father's mission, plotting elaborate attacks that Courage turns back one by one.

name: Courageous Cure/Ball of Revenge
summary:
Courageous Cure: A race of multi limbed aliens plagued by a virus that makes them punch themselves experiments on Muriel and Eustace by giving them extra arms, and Courage scrambles to find a cure before the infection spreads.

Ball of Revenge: Fed up with Courage always saving the day, Eustace invites Katz, Le Quack, the weremole, the Cajun fox and other past foes to a deadly game of dodgeball meant to destroy Courage once and for all.

name: Cabaret Courage/Wrath of the Librarian
summary:
Cabaret Courage: In glitzy Hollowood, Courage and his owners fall into an underground cabaret run by a giant infant like being who demands nonstop performances in exchange for fabulous prizes, and Courage must reach the creature's lonely heart to escape.

Wrath of the Librarian: Courage returns a long overdue library book and angers a vengeful librarian, who curses Muriel and Eustace into the book's characters until Courage can raise enough money to pay the enormous fine.

name: Remembrance of Courage Past/Perfect
summary:
Remembrance of Courage Past: Courage relives the day an evil veterinarian rocketed his parents into space, and when the same vet targets Muriel and Eustace for his experiments, Courage must prevent history from repeating itself.

Perfect: Haunted by a strict spectral teacher who appears whenever he makes a mistake, Courage is pushed toward impossible perfection until he learns to accept his flaws and realizes he is fine the way he is.
